The subject is a quadrupedal dinosaur with textured, scaly skin in shades of brown and tan. It features the characteristic three horns (two large brow horns, one smaller nasal horn) and a large, solid bony frill with marginal bumps (epoccipitals). A black support stand is visible beneath the belly, indicating it is a physical object rather than a living animal. A small white card or tag lies on the table near the front feet.
